name: KrishiDoc consumed-source development-fold sidecar
purpose: Deterministic cross-validation folds for source evidence already consumed during model development.

columns.manifest_split: original immutable manifest split; retained only for traceability
columns.fold_index: one-based fold number; blank for quarantine
columns.task_role: role derived from canonical validity and condition labels
columns.raw_crops_json: sorted JSON array preserving source crop observations
columns.raw_diagnoses_json: sorted JSON array preserving complete source diagnosis observations
columns.diagnosis_terms_json: normalized semicolon-separated diagnosis marginals used for balancing
columns.raw_states_json: sorted JSON array preserving source state observations
columns.raw_countries_json: sorted JSON array preserving source country observations
columns.raw_review_count: number of source expert-review rows for this image
columns.metadata_flags: semicolon-delimited row and group quality flags

quarantine_rule: A missing annotation or missing critical crop, diagnosis, country, or state value quarantines the complete group_id.
conflict_rule: Observed expert disagreements remain multi-valued and flagged; no visual or semantic adjudication is performed.
